description:
Update a voice agent

Changes one or more fields on a voice agent. Every field is optional and only the fields you send are written, so this is a partial update. The change is pushed to the voice engine first and then stored; if the engine rejects the push the request still succeeds and the new values are stored, so a caller that depends on live behaviour should verify the agent afterwards. The response carries the agent id and a confirmation message, not the updated agent.

agentId.description: Identifier of the voice agent. Accepted either as the public form `agent_12` or as the bare number `12`; the prefix is stripped before the lookup.

body.description: The fields to change. Sending an empty object is accepted and touches only the updated timestamp.

enableInterruptions.description: Allow user to interrupt the agent

expressiveMode.description: Expressive speech with audio tags. Takes effect with the echocall-ultra model.

firstMessage.description: Initial message spoken by the agent

optimizeStreamingLatency.description: Latency optimisation (0-4). Higher answers faster at slightly lower quality. Default: 3.

similarityBoost.description: How closely the speech follows the original voice (0.0-1.0). Default: 0.75.

suggestedAudioTags.description: Up to 20 audio tags (for example "happy", "whispers") the agent may use in expressive mode.

supportedLanguages.description: All supported languages as ISO-639-1 codes.

transferNumbers.description: Phone numbers the agent can transfer calls to.

ttsModel.description: Text-to-speech model. Leave unset for automatic selection based on `language`. `echocall-flash`: fast, multilingual (recommended default). `echocall-flash-lite`: fastest, English only. `echocall-ultra`: most expressive/natural, supports emotional audio tags, widest language coverage. `echocall-multilingual`: balanced multilingual quality. Each model supports a different set of languages for `language`/`supportedLanguages` - pick a model that covers your target language(s), otherwise the request may fail.

name: update_agent
title: Update a voice agent
